author: Claude taslak (H-071); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geniş zamanda (present simple); Türkçede doğal anlatım için çoğunlukla şimdiki zaman (-iyor) kullanıldı.
Hareket ve yer edatları (over, up, down, into, after, near) kelime anlamında cümledeki kullanımına göre verildi.
-s takısı olan fiillerde (flies, runs, goes) not düşüldü.

lines.en: Today, Ravi's red kite flies over the town.
lines.tr: Bugün Ravi'nin kırmızı uçurtması kasabanın üstünden uçuyor.

lines.en: He lives in a town by the sea.
His home is on a hill.
It has a small balcony with flowers.
lines.tr: Evin çiçekli küçük bir balkonu var.

lines.en: Ravi and his dad make the kite.
lines.tr: Uçurtmayı Ravi ve babası birlikte yapıyor.

lines.en: Where does the kite go today?
The park is on top of the hill.
There are tall trees and green grass.
lines.tr: Uzun ağaçlar ve yeşil çimen var.

lines.en: It dances in the blue sky.
Then the wind is very strong.
There are apples, oranges and bananas.
He has a big white hat.
Now Ravi is on a long street.
Cars and bikes go up and down.
lines.tr: Arabalar ve bisikletler aşağı yukarı gidip geliyor.

lines.en: An old yellow tram comes down the street.
lines.tr: Caddeden eski, sarı bir tramvay iniyor.

lines.en: It is on top of the tram!
The tram stops at the corner.

words.gets: (get + -s; gets on: biniyor, gets off: iniyor)

lines.en: The tram goes down, down, down.
Ravi can see pink houses and blue houses.
lines.tr: Ravi pembe ve mavi evleri görebiliyor.

words.gets: (get + -s; gets on: biniyor, gets off: iniyor)
words.off: -den aşağı (gets off: iniyor; jumps off: atlıyor)

lines.en: The kite flies over a high wall.
lines.tr: Uçurtma yüksek bir duvarın üstünden uçuyor.

lines.en: Ravi can't go over the wall.
On the wall, there is a black cat.
lines.tr: Duvarın üstünde siyah bir kedi var.

lines.en: "Do you see my kite?" asks Ravi.
The cat looks at the sky.
Then it looks at the river.
Now Ravi is at the river.
There are big boats and small boats.
lines.tr: Büyük tekneler ve küçük tekneler var.

lines.en: Ravi can't go over the river.
It is on a white boat!
The boat is on the other side.
And the red kite goes with it!
There is a small green ferry.
It goes to the other side.

lines.tr: "Ben de gelebilir miyim, lütfen?" diye soruyor Ravi.

lines.en: The ferry goes over the river.
The wind is in Ravi's hair.
He can see the white boat.
The kite is still on it.
Soon they are on the other side.

words.off: -den aşağı (gets off: iniyor; jumps off: atlıyor)

lines.en: Ravi can see the red kite.
The kite goes up into the sky.
Now it flies back over the river!
Ravi runs after the kite again.
Here there is a long bridge.
The kite flies over the market.
The kite flies up the hill.
Ravi runs up the hill, too.
The red kite is in some flowers.
They are on a small balcony.
He is tired, hot and very happy.
The morning wind goes to the river.

phrases.note: Yer/hareket edatı: over = bir şeyin üstünden (geçerek). The kite flies over the trees.
after = arkasından. Ravi runs after the kite.
Tersi: gets off = inmek. Türkçede "binmek" tek kelime; İngilizcede fiil + edat.

words.gets: (get + -s; gets on: biniyor, gets off: iniyor)

phrases.note: Saatten önce "at": at nine, at twelve. Tam saatte o'clock da denebilir: twelve o'clock.
can + not. Her kişiyle aynı: I can't, he can't. ~~He can'ts~~ yok.
